project: JARVIS TRADER Sprint 18 — Phase 1 System Verification
description: Phase 1 goal is a working system, not strategy optimization. The trading strategy (parameters, rules, WFE targets) has not been approved and will be built from scratch in Phase 2. Sprint 18 verifies the system works end-to-end: engine starts cleanly, schedulers fire on schedule, signals reach the pipeline, trades flow from approval through to IB Gateway paper fill, and the dashboard shows accurate real-time data. No parameter tuning, no WFE experiments, no RL training.

userStories.title: Engine health verification — confirm clean startup and scheduler firing
userStories.description: As the system operator, I need to verify the engine starts without errors, all routers register correctly, and all APScheduler jobs are registered and firing on schedule so I know the system is operationally sound.
acceptanceCriteria: Start the engine: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn main:app --port 8010 (NO --reload flag). Capture the startup log output. Confirm: zero ERROR or CRITICAL lines during startup, all routers listed as registered, APScheduler shows all 6 jobs scheduled (market_open_scan, eod_summary, morning_briefing, weekly_review, vix_hourly, nightly_learning_consolidator).
Hit the health endpoint: GET http://localhost:8010/health — confirm HTTP 200 and response includes engine_status: 'ok'.

Hit the scheduler status endpoint if it exists: GET http://localhost:8010/scheduler/jobs — list all scheduled jobs with their next_run_time. If endpoint does not exist, add GET /scheduler/jobs to engine/routers/scheduler_router.py returning [{id, name, next_run_time, trigger}] for all registered APScheduler jobs.

Trigger a manual scan to verify the pipeline runs end-to-end without crashing: POST http://localhost:8010/scanner/run or equivalent endpoint with body {symbol: 'MCL'}. Confirm HTTP 200 and no 500 errors in logs. The result can be HOLD or a signal — what matters is the pipeline completed without exception.
Check engine logs for any recurring errors after 10 minutes of uptime: look for repeated ERROR lines that indicate a background task is failing silently.
Write docs/reports/sprint18_system_health.md with: startup log summary (errors/warnings count), list of registered APScheduler jobs with next_run_time, manual scan result, any recurring errors found.
All Python ruff-clean. 0 test failures.
userStories.notes: Engine requires restart after S16/S17 changes. Run without --reload flag per CLAUDE.md safety rules.

userStories.title: Paper trade end-to-end flow verification
userStories.description: As a trader, I need to verify that the complete paper trade flow works without errors — from signal generation through approval through SQLite write through IB Gateway paper routing — so I know the system can actually execute trades.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify a pending approval can be created: POST http://localhost:8010/pipeline/run or equivalent with symbol='MCL'. If the pipeline returns HOLD, that is acceptable — confirm a pending_approval row was NOT created (HOLD should not create approvals). If it returns a BUY/SELL signal, confirm a pending_approval row WAS created in engine/data/jarvis_trader.db.

If no live signal is available, inject a test approval directly: POST http://localhost:8010/approvals/pending with a synthetic MCL BUY approval payload. Confirm HTTP 201 and the row appears in the pending_approvals table in SQLite.

Approve the pending trade: POST http://localhost:8010/approvals/{id}/approve. Confirm: (a) paper_trades table gets a new row with status='open', entry_price non-NULL, pnl=NULL (trade is open), (b) the response includes execution field showing either 'placed' (IB Gateway connected) or 'broker_unavailable' (IB Gateway not running — this is acceptable).

Close the test trade: POST http://localhost:8010/paper/close/{trade_id} or equivalent with exit_price. Confirm: (a) paper_trades row updates to status='closed', exit_price non-NULL, pnl non-NULL (computed by the US-1702 fix), (b) the learning classifier hook fires (check logs for '[LEARNING] Trade classified' line).
Query final state: SELECT symbol, direction, entry_price, exit_price, pnl, status FROM paper_trades WHERE id={trade_id}. Confirm all fields non-NULL and pnl = correct computed value.
Append results to docs/reports/sprint18_system_health.md: E2E flow result (pass/fail), each step's HTTP status, final paper_trades row, pnl computation accuracy.
All Python ruff-clean. 0 test failures.
userStories.notes: IB Gateway may not be running — broker_unavailable is acceptable. The critical path is SQLite write correctness, not IB fill. Verified 2026-04-03: full E2E flow passed — approval injected, approved via API, paper_trades row written (open), closed via /portfolio/paper/trade, pnl=$100.00 confirmed (MCL multiplier 100x, entry=68.5, exit=69.5, qty=1). Learning classifier returned grade B, R-multiple 2.00.

userStories.title: Dashboard data accuracy verification
userStories.description: As a trader, I need the dashboard to show accurate real-time data — correct trade count, correct P&L, and correct validation gate status — now that the DB path and pnl write fixes from Sprint 17 are in place.
acceptanceCriteria: With the engine running, open the dashboard at http://localhost:3010. Navigate to the main dashboard page. Confirm no console errors, no 'Failed to fetch' errors, and the widgets load within 5 seconds.
Navigate to Pending Approvals (/trades/pending-approvals). Confirm the page loads and SWR refresh is working (check that the 'Last updated' timestamp updates every 5 seconds).

Navigate to the Validation Gates page (/paper/validation/gates). Confirm: (a) trade count shows the actual number of paper trades (should be close to 9-11 from the migration), (b) PF and Sharpe show numeric values (not null/NaN/undefined), (c) days elapsed shows correct count from 2026-04-02.
Navigate to Paper Trading (/paper or equivalent). Confirm the balance widget shows a non-zero, non-anomalous value consistent with starting capital +/- actual closed trade PnL.
Hit GET http://localhost:8010/paper-validation/summary/eod directly. Confirm all numeric fields (trades_closed, profit_factor, sharpe_ratio, win_rate, max_drawdown) are numbers, not null.
Document any dashboard widget that still shows null, NaN, or clearly wrong data — these become targeted bugs for Sprint 19 rather than blockers for Sprint 18.
Append results to docs/reports/sprint18_system_health.md: dashboard page health summary, any widgets still broken, EOD summary endpoint response.
userStories.notes: Verified 2026-04-03. 10 bugs documented as Sprint 19 backlog in docs/reports/sprint18_system_health.md. Dashboard home page has React hydration ISE; /paper/validation/gates and /summary/eod return 500 due to wrong absolute import path (engine.database). Portfolio balance endpoint works ($10,130). Build passes 26/26 routes, 0 TS errors.

userStories.title: IB Gateway E2E smoke test
userStories.description: As a trader, I need to verify that IB Gateway paper trading is reachable and that a paper order can be routed through the approval system to IB so that the broker connection is confirmed working before live paper trading begins.
acceptanceCriteria: PREREQUISITE CHECK: Confirm IB_ACCOUNT_ID is set in engine/.env (not 'YOUR_IBKR_ACCOUNT_ID'). If not set, write clear instructions: 'ACTION REQUIRED: Open engine/.env and set IB_ACCOUNT_ID to your IBKR paper account ID (found in IB Gateway → Account menu). Then re-run this story.' Do not proceed past this check if not set.

PREREQUISITE CHECK: Confirm IB Gateway is running on port 4002 (paper mode): python -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.settimeout(2); result=s.connect_ex(('127.0.0.1',4002)); print('IB Gateway reachable' if result==0 else 'IB Gateway NOT reachable on 4002'); s.close()". If not reachable, write instructions for starting IB Gateway and mark story as blocked-on-Matt.
If both prerequisites pass: run the existing smoke test script: cd engine && .venv/Scripts/python ../scripts/smoke_test_approvals.py. Capture full output.

If smoke test passes: attempt a live IB Gateway connection test via the engine's IBGatewayConnector: python -c "import asyncio; from engine.execution.ib_gateway import IBGatewayConnector; conn = IBGatewayConnector(); asyncio.run(conn.connect()); print('Connected:', conn.is_connected())" — run from the engine/ directory with the venv active.

Document result: connected / not connected / blocked-on-prerequisites. If connected, confirm the paper account ID matches and the connection is to port 4002 (not 4001 — live port is permanently blocked).
Append to docs/reports/sprint18_system_health.md: IB Gateway prereq check results, smoke test output, connection test result.
userStories.notes: IB_ACCOUNT_ID must be set by Matt in engine/.env before this story can complete. IB Gateway must be running on port 4002 (paper mode only — port 4001 is permanently blocked).

userStories.title: Daily ops runbook — what Matt runs every trading day
userStories.description: As the system operator, I need a clear, tested daily checklist for starting, monitoring, and shutting down JARVIS TRADER each trading day so that operations are repeatable and nothing is forgotten.
acceptanceCriteria: Read engine/docs/runbooks/ and docs/runbooks/ for any existing runbook content. Incorporate it rather than duplicating.

Write docs/runbooks/daily_ops.md covering the complete daily routine: (1) Pre-market startup sequence (IB Gateway → engine restart → smoke test → dashboard check), (2) RTH monitoring (what to watch, how to approve pending trades, when to intervene), (3) EOD shutdown sequence (confirm EOD job ran, check daily P&L, confirm DB written correctly), (4) What to do if engine crashes (restart command, log location, how to check for lost trades), (5) Weekly tasks (check rolling WFE dashboard, review learning loop output).

Include exact commands for every step — no vague instructions. Every command must use the correct venv path (.venv/Scripts/python), the correct DB path (engine/data/jarvis_trader.db), and the correct port (8010 engine, 3010 dashboard, 4002 IB Gateway paper).

Include a pre-market checklist table that Matt can scan in 60 seconds: engine running (Y/N), IB Gateway port 4002 (Y/N), smoke test passed (Y/N), Anthropic credits > $10 (Y/N), pending approvals reviewed (Y/N).
Test every command in the runbook by running it. Mark each with 'VERIFIED 2026-04-03' so future sessions know which commands are tested.
Append to docs/reports/sprint18_system_health.md: link to the new runbook, confirmation that all commands were verified.
userStories.notes: Runbook is the Phase 1 completion artifact. When Matt can run through this checklist every morning in under 5 minutes, Phase 1 is done.
